_comment: Per-file line cap for hand-written code modules, enforced by the harness (PreToolUse block) and `interlinked verify` (large_files check). `files` grandfathers offenders (repo-relative path -> recorded line count): a listed file may shrink or hold, but the harness blocks any edit that grows it past its recorded count and verify flags it only if it grows. Ratcheted 1500->1000 (2026-06-01), 1000->800 (2026-06-03), then 800->500 (2026-06-13) — this time grandfathering the existing over-500 modules and decomposing them down over a multi-step campaign (each split into a re-exporting entry + sibling helpers; importers unchanged). Drop each file from `files` as it falls below max_lines; the goal end-state is an empty list. Codegen DATA (hook-template-chunks/session-state.ts, hooks-template.ts) is exempt via the @codegen-data header marker, not grandfathered. max_lines and DEFAULT_MAX_LINES are pinned equal (large-file-policy.test.ts). Policy: src/harness/large-file-policy.ts.
